build_crf_transition_graph: build a bigram transition graph for a linear-chain CRF with a given number of classes
build_crf_potential_graph: build a unary potential graph for a linear-chain CRF with given features and classes
create_crf_model: create a linear-chain CRF model with random arc weights for potentials and transitions
sample_crf_model: sample sequences from a trained linear-chain CRF model using Viterbi decoding
run_crf_training: run SGD training loop for a linear-chain CRF with loss computation and gradient updates
